english.note: Use this when winning someone over to your side or cultivating their support, often with a slightly calculated tone.

examples.english: He often takes his colleagues out for meals to woo them into supporting him.
examples.traditional: 佢成日請同事食飯，想拉攏佢哋支持自己。
